blocks.content: The game ends when the player loses all their lives. But there is another way it can end.
What happens when every brick is destroyed?
Right now, nothing. The ball keeps bouncing around an empty canvas. That needs to change.
After each brick collision, check whether the entire array has been cleared:
You already have a GAME_OVER state. You do not need a separate WIN state. The distinction between winning and losing only matters when rendering the overlay. So you handle it there:
Green for a win. Red for a loss. Same state, same screen, different message.
Keeping the state machine simple pays off here. One fewer state means one fewer transition to manage and one fewer thing that can go wrong.
Next, you will look at one final stability fix before the game is complete.
